property_summary: For any input where _tos is non-empty and the callee address implements a function transferFrom that returns (i.e. the low-level call succeeds), the reference C.transfer always completes successfully (does not revert) and returns true; the mutant inverts the inner require and will revert whenever the callee call succeeds, so there exist inputs (a non-empty _tos and a callee that accepts the call) that make the mutant revert while the reference succeeds.
change_summary: Invert the require to revert when the caddress.call returns true, causing successful inner calls to cause overall revert and change return behavior.
